chunks: "What ending is more decisive than the taslim?"

key_terms.التَّسْلِيمِ: the taslim, the salutation concluding the prayer
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What indicates the most decisive ending of the prayer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the decisive role of the taslim in concluding the prayer. It highlights that the prayer is brought to completion and separation from its state by the taslim.
